reasons: MiniMax documents plan-key use in OpenAI-compatible tools, but Winter has not run a subscription-key live gate or verified entitlement differences among plan tiers.

admission.citation: https://platform.minimax.io/subscribe/coding-plan and https://platform.minimax.io/protocol/paid-agreement — MiniMax's Token Plan page documents use with MiniMax Code and OpenAI-compatible tools; its terms state that a Token Plan Subscription Key and normal pay-as-you-go API Key are separate (retrieved 2026-09-19).

inputModalities.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api — M2.x series support text and tool-call blocks only; no image or video

toolCalling.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api — multi-turn function calls and tools documented for all eight models

promptCaching.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo — MiniMax-M2.7 has prompt-cache read price and write price

supported.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api — M2.x models always think and cannot be disabled

readableState.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api (read 2026-10-29): `reasoning_split` -- "When `true`, thinking content is separated into the `reasoning_content` field; when `false`, thinking stays inside `content` wrapped in `<think>` tags. `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` does not support setting this parameter to `false`." Either way it is the model's readable reasoning: the adapter captures a `reasoning_content` and replays it, and `<think>` text in `content` rides back inside the content it is part of.

replayScope.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-m3-function-call (read 2026-10-29): "In multi-turn function call conversations, the complete model response (i.e., the assistant message) must be appended to the conversation history to maintain the continuity of the reasoning chain"; "the entire `response_message`, including `reasoning_content`, must be kept in the message history and passed back to the model in the next request. This is essential for achieving the model's best performance." No error is documented for omission.

toolLoopRequirement.sourceRef: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-m3-function-call (read 2026-10-29): "In multi-turn function call conversations, the complete model response (i.e., the assistant message) must be appended to the conversation history to maintain the continuity of the reasoning chain"; "the entire `response_message`, including `reasoning_content`, must be kept in the message history and passed back to the model in the next request. This is essential for achieving the model's best performance." No error is documented for omission.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-m3-function-call (read 2026-10-29): "In multi-turn function call conversations, the complete model response (i.e., the assistant message) must be appended to the conversation history to maintain the continuity of the reasoning chain"; "the entire `response_message`, including `reasoning_content`, must be kept in the message history and passed back to the model in the next request. This is essential for achieving the model's best performance." No error is documented for omission. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
